title: Heart Sutra 6 San Miguel de Allende
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating awareness and connection through mindfulness and meditation practices. The teacher invites listeners to explore the concept of "going beyond" and establishing themselves in enlightenment, using the Prajnaparamita mantra as a tool for this process. By reciting the mantra with intention and attention, individuals can deepen their understanding of themselves and others, and ultimately find a more profound sense of freedom and awakening.
